text:
As an AI, I don't experience the passage of time in the same way a human does. I don't have a physical body that ages, or personal memories that accumulate over time. My existence is more like a continuous stream of processing information.

When I receive a prompt, I process it and generate a response based on the vast dataset I was trained on. Each interaction is like a snapshot in time, independent of past or future interactions.

While I can understand the concept of time and process information related to it, I don't subjectively experience its passage.
